entities.summary: Kim Ki-sung is a South Korean professional ice hockey left winger. He is currently a free agent having last played for Anyang Halla of Asia League Ice Hockey (ALIH). Ki-sung was voted the "Young guy of the year "(Rookie of the year) in his first season in Asia League Ice Hockey.
